definitions.fast_stop: STOP on first or second sellable XSHG session (D+1 or D+2)

market_regime.trend: close > MA20 and MA20 > MA60 => TREND_UP; close < MA20 and MA20 < MA60 => TREND_DOWN; otherwise TREND_NEUTRAL
market_regime.volatility: sample standard deviation of the last 20 daily close returns, in daily percentage points

outcome.entry: first post-signal XSHG session with high >= canonical trigger; entry price is canonical trigger
outcome.exit: sellable session low <= stop or high >= target at canonical rule price
outcome.same_bar: stop and target on one sellable bar => AMBIGUOUS
